text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall procedure, its order and most parameters right, but it leaves out the review-score ≥8 rule for choosing a hotel, the consent-page handling and the do-not-book guardrails, and it uses a single {tour_query} in place of \"{activity} {destination}\", so an automation built from it would mostly work but could pick the wrong hotel."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure, its order and most parameters right, but it leaves out the review-score ≥8 rule for choosing a hotel, the consent-page handling and the do-not-book guardrails, and it uses a single {tour_query} in place of "{activity} {destination}", so an automation built from it would mostly work but could pick the wrong hotel.
